paragraph: The ministry, MASFAMU, [said it launched the modernisation and expansion phase of the Cadastro Social Único on 20 July 2026](<https://masfamu.gov.ao/home>). It says the phase promotes interoperability between public institutions. A [World Bank status report of 25 October 2024](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099102524042530084/pdf/P169779177dc6e0f518d2610fb44ed3049d.pdf>) said the registry was still not operational as of mid-2024. In the last twelve months, the July 2026 launch is the one dated step found. No source found since October 2023 says a registry or programme exchanges data in use. Establishing would need a system in use exchanging data with the national ID, a payment provider or another programme.

In January 2026 a [World Bank blog said the CORE-MIS of the Merankabandi (Cash for Jobs) programme connects with several payment service providers](<https://blogs.worldbank.org/en/nasikiliza/burundi-cash-for-jobs-project-is-embracing-smart-it-for-social-impact>). In May 2026 the [World Bank said the Merankabandi social registry is also used by the Soleil-Nyakiriza solar energy project](<https://www.worldbank.org/en/results/2026/05/01/building-burundi-s-national-social-protection-systems-to-deliver-jobs-and-respond-to-crises>). The project uses it to reach vulnerable households for subsidised solar kits. Both statements are from the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the registry is linked to the national ID and to another sector. Mature would need the registry linked to the national ID and to civil registration, health, education or tax.

On 15 June 2026 the World Bank [approved US$120 million for a project in Burkina Faso](<https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2026/07/15/burkina-faso-new-world-bank-financing-to-expand-economic-opportunities-and-strengthen-social-protection-systems>) that finances integration of the Registre Social Unique with the IDP, health-insurance and other key beneficiary databases. [In May 2026 its appraisal document said the RSU and the data on internally displaced persons are managed separately](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099052726095539002/pdf/BOSIB-9b77474f-0575-4c43-a165-babff2ee4d7b.pdf>), with coordination efforts under way. The RSU covers about a quarter of poor and vulnerable households. The funding and the appraisal are from the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a registry or programme exchanges data in use. Establishing would need a system in use that exchanges data with the national ID, a payment provider or another programme.

No stage is set. [In 2022 the World Bank said the social registry is linked to OMANG, the national ID, for validation](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099645103062256866/pdf/P1721750af4ddb0ce098d30b331412b0ab8.pdf>). [By March 2025, 98 per cent of beneficiaries of the five main poverty-targeted social programmes had been updated in the Single Social Registry](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099121825122532143/txt/BOSIB-35f31917-1454-433b-a021-4d7246073f71.txt>), and the World Bank's completion report set the target at 75.8 per cent. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Nothing found since October 2023 names social protection systems exchanging data. Establishing would need a source after that date showing an exchange in use with the national ID, a payment provider or another programme.

In May 2026 the World Bank said a project's [registration system will consolidate the parent project's beneficiary databases](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099060226181018944/pdf/BOSIB-b67bf62d-5670-4d2e-9c1c-d85c2fdb544c.pdf>). It will cross-check the data against existing registries to reduce duplication. A [World Bank appraisal says the Unified Social Registry (RSU), begun in 2018, is delayed](<https://ewsdata.rightsindevelopment.org/files/documents/11/WB-P179211_5aXsjNN.pdf>). The Safety Nets Project will fund its management information system. In the last twelve months, the May 2026 statement is the dated step found. No source found since October 2023 says a registry or programme exchanges data in use. Establishing would need a system in use exchanging data with the national ID, a payment provider or another programme.

[BCPFS and ONECI signed a convention on 2 April 2026](<https://filetsociaux-ci.org/registre-social-unique-des-menages-pauvres-et-vulnerables-rsu-signature-dune-convention-entre-le-bureau-de-coordination-du-programme-filets-sociaux-bcpfs-et-loffice-nation/>) to interconnect the RSU with ONECI databases and the RNPP. In September 2025 a [workshop at Grand-Bassam set out to update the RSU's interoperability framework](<https://filetsociaux-ci.org/atelier-sur-linteroperabilite-des-systemes-dinformation-pour-renforcer-la-protection-sociale-en-cote-divoire/>), and [the national interoperability platform began](<https://digitalmag.ci/cote-divoire-cinq-administrations-publiques-integrent-la-plateforme-dinteroperabilite/>). In the last twelve months, five administrations joined that platform by July 2026, and the convention was signed. No source found since October 2023 says a registry or programme exchanges data in use. Establishing would need a system in use exchanging data with the national ID, a payment provider or another programme.

In October 2025 Cameroon was [assessing its ID, civil registration and disability systems for linking to the Unified Social Registry](<https://spdci.org/resource/across-21-countries-a-shared-journey-toward-inclusive-and-digital-social-protection/>), the Digital Convergence Initiative said. In the last twelve months, Cameroon's health ministry said in November 2026 that its interoperability platform [links universal health coverage enrolment and billing](<https://scores2000.info/2026/11/sante-numerique-le-cameroun-accelere-l-interconnexion-de-ses-systemes-d-information-sanitaires.html>). A 2021 World Bank appraisal [plans the registry under the social affairs ministry](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099150001062231657/pdf/Project0Inform0n0Project000P175363.pdf>), to merge four existing beneficiary databases. No source found since October 2023 says two or more programmes draw on one registry. Operating would need two or more programmes drawing beneficiaries from one shared registry.

Congo's [joint arrete of 20 August 2024 states that the registre social unique is an interoperable information system](<https://liziba.cg/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Arrete-n-18503-du-20-aout-2024-fixant-les-regles-de-collecte-de-traitement-dechange-et-dactualisation-des-donnees-du-registre-social-unique.pdf>). [Article 8 draws its data from the civil-status information systems and the unique identification number](<https://liziba.cg/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Arrete-n-18503-du-20-aout-2024-fixant-les-regles-de-collecte-de-traitement-dechange-et-dactualisation-des-donnees-du-registre-social-unique.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [a workshop on 27-28 January 2026 reported survey data migrated to the PSIPJ general beneficiary register](<https://fr.allafrica.com/stories/202601290559.html>). The data came from five Talangai districts. On 10 April 2026 [the social affairs minister said three programmes now have the RSU as a common source of information](<https://affaires-sociales.gouv.cg/2026/04/14/le-registre-social-unique-du-congo-dispose-dun-siege-approprie/>). They are health insurance, safety net and insertion.

No stage is set. In February 2024 the minister [said about 16 social programmes draw beneficiaries from the CSU](<https://www.governo.cv/governo-lanca-mecanismo-de-gestao-das-informacoes-e-reclamacoes-do-cadastro-social-unico/>). In the last twelve months, [in June 2026 the government said the Cadastro Social Único is the base of the country's social support system](<https://www.governo.cv/apelo-ao-registo-no-cadastro-social-unico-csu-para-agregados-familiares-em-zonas-climaticamente-vulneraveis/>). A registered eligible household can access cash transfers, food security support and resilience programmes. Nothing found since October 2023 names social protection systems exchanging data. Establishing would need a source after that date showing an exchange in use with the national ID, a payment provider or another programme.

On 14 March 2025 the World Bank [approved the US$31 million Integrated Community Resilience Project](<https://projects.worldbank.org/en/projects-operations/project-detail/P506969>). One component scales the national Social Registry with an ANSIE interoperability upgrade. [Decree 2020-137, of July 2020, makes the Registre Social the sole targeting tool for beneficiaries of social programmes](<https://www.journalofficiel.dj/texte-juridique/decret-n2020-137-pr-mass-portant-modification-du-decret-n2017-311-pr-seas-du-28-septembre-2017-portant-creation-organisation-et-fonctionnement-du-registre-social/>). In the last twelve months, [a director general said in July 2026 that an interoperability system is being built](<https://www.lanation.dj/notre-vision-est-de-faire-de-la-direction-generale-de-la-population-et-de-la-famille-une-administration-entierement-modernisee-interconnectee-et-proche-des-citoyens-abdi-abdillahi-obsie/>). It will let social protection bodies verify national ID cards in real time. No source found since October 2023 says a registry or programme exchanges data in use. Establishing would need a system in use exchanging data with the national ID, a payment provider or another programme.

[In April 2026 the CNAS social insurance fund and the CNR pensions fund were exchanging data instantly through the national identification number](<https://www.algerie360.com/securite-sociale-la-cnas-lance-de-nouveaux-services-pour-les-employeurs/>). In the last twelve months, the Ministry of National Solidarity was [testing a unified digital platform in two districts in March 2026](<https://www.dzair-tube.dz/en/algeria-launches-pilot-digital-services-platform-for-national-solidarity-sector/>). The pilot covered the AFS allowance and the card for persons with special needs. Database links were still being checked. No source found since October 2023 says two or more programmes share one registry. Operating would need two or more programmes drawing beneficiaries from one shared registry.

Egypt's national social registry [draws on 27 government databases through the national ID number, a Ministry of Social Solidarity official said in November 2026](<https://almessa.gomhuriaonline.com/764443/>). [In August 2026 the ministry said Law 12 of 2025 made the social registry the single source for every cash-transfer beneficiary database](<https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4343435>). [The World Bank says cash-plus schemes run with UNFPA, UNDP and WFP target people from the Takaful and Karama registry](<https://www.worldbank.org/en/results/2024/05/28/promoting-inclusive-human-capital-development-and-building-resilience-in-egypt-through-cash-transfer-programs>). Both ministry statements are from the last twelve months. No source found names a link from the registry to civil registration, health, education or tax records. Mature would need the registry linked to the national ID and to civil registration, health, education or tax.

[In 2025 OpenG2P said the relief programme's social registry, run for the Ethiopian Disaster Risk Management Commission, was seeded from Fayda, the national ID](<https://id4africa.com/2025/files/T3-P1-S2-OpenG2P-Final.pdf>), and that Fayda is integrated with it to keep its records clean. In March 2024 the World Bank said it was [supporting a government pilot paying safety-net benefits through Telebirr mobile money](<https://blogs.worldbank.org/en/nasikiliza/leveraging-e-payments-financial-inclusion-ethiopia-afe-0324>) in two regions. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says two or more programmes draw on one shared registry. Operating would need two or more programmes drawing beneficiaries from one shared registry.

On 28 April 2026 [the tax office, CNSS and CNAMGS began work on one wage declaration](<https://www.gabonreview.com/dus-un-tournant-numerique-pour-la-transparence-salariale-au-gabon/>) that all three would read, to operate from July 2026. [Gabon's amended World Bank financing, from September 2026, pays to join the CNAM-GS registry to the interoperability platform](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099090226132027563/pdf/P175987-8dfb5a41-ff83-4fc0-a597-c588997e88ba.pdf>), and the registry is also to be linked to the RBPP identity register. Both are from the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a registry or programme exchanges data in use. Establishing would need a system in use that exchanges data with the national ID, a payment provider or another programme.

The Ghana National Household Registry's [July 2026 privacy policy says it links its data with the identity, health insurance and education authorities](<https://gnhr.mogcsp.gov.gh/privacy.php>). [The registry describes itself as the main platform for targeting LEAP, school feeding and health insurance enrolment](<https://gnhr.mogcsp.gov.gh/registry.php>). In the last twelve months, [in August 2026 the social protection ministry said its programmes run in silos, each on its own servers](<https://www.mogcsp.gov.gh/?mdocs-file=8618>). It sought a firm to build a common data exchange platform. No source found states how much data the registry exchanges with each authority.

On 27 June 2024 [the ANIES and FDSI directors general signed a protocol for ANIES to use secured RSU data](<https://anies.gov.gn/guichet-choc-alimentaire-lanies-et-le-fdsi-signent-un-protocole-daccord/>). It serves the IMF-financed Guichet Choc Alimentaire project. In the last twelve months, [on 8 July 2026 the FDSI director general said RSU data had been used by that project](<https://mediaguinee.com/2026/07/guinee-le-fdsi-presente-le-rapport-danalyse-du-registre-social-unifie-qui-cartographie-977-610-menages-soit-4-860-075-individus-a-travers-le-pays/>), and by UNICEF to follow malnourished children. UNICEF's representative said the planned register is to be linkable to a unique national identification number. No source found since October 2023 says the registry is linked to the national ID and to another sector. Mature would need the registry linked to the national ID and to civil registration, health, education or tax.

In 2019 a [World Bank framework said Gambian social protection agencies worked separately, with little information shared across them](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/730471557474095639/txt/Building-The-Gambias-Social-Registry-Final-Draft-Framework-for-the-Design-and-Road-Map-Leading-to-Implementation.txt>). In April 2024 a [World Bank blog said the Gambia Social Registry covered 203,022 households in 40 of 43 districts](<https://blogs.worldbank.org/en/nasikiliza/the-gambia-social-registry-a-success-story-in-systems-building>). The latest source, from November 2025, is a [World Bank status report on the RISE project saying social registry enhancements and interoperability efforts had progressed](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099112925154035950/pdf/P179233-79b99711-b6ff-4c20-b5cb-2d5ef7838226.pdf>). No change dated within the last twelve months has been found. No source found since October 2023 says a registry or programme exchanges data in use. Establishing would need a system in use that exchanges data with the national ID, a payment provider or another programme.

[In August 2025 all four National Safety Net Programme cash transfers used the Enhanced Single Registry](<https://www.socialprotection.go.ke/sites/default/files/Downloads/ESMP%20Template-August%202025%20(3).pdf>). [In February 2026 the cash transfer programme's information system was linked to Civil Registration Services](<https://chasp.co.ke/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Feb-Newsletter.pdf>), which flags deceased beneficiaries for exit. In the last twelve months, [in September 2026 the State Department for Social Protection was hiring consultants to link the registry with SHA, NSSF, IPRS and civil registration](<https://www.kenyans.co.ke/news/127262-govt-moves-link-sha-nssf-social-protection-database>). The World Bank's KSEIP-2 funds the upgrade. [In October 2025 the Health Cabinet Secretary said the registry identified 558,000 indigent households](<https://www.the-star.co.ke/news/2025-10-30-sha-system-stopped-theft-of-millions-in-fake-claims-duale>). Mature would need the registry linked to the national ID and to civil registration, health, education or tax.

[The World Bank status report gives five programmes using the Liberia Household Social Registry at 9 June 2025](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099072825133035694/pdf/P174417-17056a8a-f1db-4adb-af5f-982e8fb95722.pdf>), up from four in December 2024. In the last twelve months, [the REALISE project page said all its transfers are delivered digitally through MTN mobile money, as at the 6 May 2026 meeting](<https://realise.liberiasp.gov.lr/2026/05/18/government-of-liberia-presents-crisis-response-plan-to-world-bank/>). The status report adds that enhancements to the registry are ongoing. They prepare for integration with other national systems. No source found since October 2023 says the registry is linked to the national ID and to another sector. Mature would need the registry linked to the national ID and to civil registration, health, education or tax.

On 10 July 2025 Libya's Minister of Social Affairs, Wafaa al-Kilani, [followed up activation of an electronic link for the wife-and-children grant](<https://lana.gov.ly/post.php?id=336411&lang=ar>). The ministry built the link with the Civil Status Authority to keep data accurate and stop delays and duplicate payments. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a registry or programme exchanges data in use. Establishing would need a system in use that exchanges data with the national ID, a payment provider or another programme.

NISSA is Lesotho's national social assistance database. [In June 2025 UNICEF said a tablet-based birth registration system feeds NISSA in real time](<https://lesotho.un.org/en/296588-every-child-counts-linking-nutrition-water-and-identity-better-future>). [In April 2024 the ministry sought a consultant to build and test a link between NISSA and the national identity and civil registry](<https://selibeng.com/eoi-lesotho-nissa-systems-development-enhancement-consultancy/>). [NISSA's system, completed in January 2016, served the Child Grants Programme, the OVC Bursary and Public Assistance](<https://lesotho.un.org/en/274430-request-proposals-national-information-system-social-assistance-nissa-social-registry-and>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. Nothing since October 2023 says two or more programmes share the registry. Operating would need two or more programmes drawing beneficiaries from one shared registry.

In 2024 [the RSU checked each household's declared data against over 30 administrative databases](<https://aujourdhui.ma/actualite/operation-extension-de-lidentifiant-digital-civil-et-social>), the Ministry of Interior says. In September 2025 [the government reported 5.3 million families in the RSU](<https://maroc.ma/fr/actualites/le-gouvernement-attache-la-mise-en-oeuvre-optimale-du-chantier-de-generalisation-de-la-protection>). [The ANSS annual report says the RNP and the RSU were crossed in 2025 to target direct aid](<https://www.lebrief.ma/soutien-social-un-an-apres-impact-de-lanss-100155241/>). In the last twelve months, [a 2026 deck says the RNP's authentication service checks what applicants declare for six social programmes, the RSU among them](<https://connect.mosip.io/resources_pdf_2026/Collaborations_between_Governments_and_Academic_Institutions.pdf>). No source found names a link from the registry to civil registration, health, education or tax records. Mature would need the registry linked to the national ID and to civil registration, health, education or tax.

In January 2026 [a World Bank appraisal-stage document proposed additional financing for Madagascar's Safety Nets and Resilience Project](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099012326100017065/txt/P179466-b0e3c23f-4024-4dae-9418-88897afe4e50.txt>), to fund further work on the FID's information systems. The work includes interoperability with the social registry, identification systems and the government interoperability platform. In the last twelve months, that proposal is the one dated step found. No source found since October 2023 says a registry or programme exchanges data in use. Establishing would need a system in use that exchanges data with the national ID, a payment provider or another programme.

In July 2026 the Caisse Malienne de Sécurité Sociale [presented a digital pension payment scheme whose pilot with the Banque de Développement du Mali was judged conclusive](<https://maliemergenceinfo.com/2026/07/28/%f0%9d%90%8ba-digitalisation-des-services-de-la-sante-et-du-developpement-social-l%f0%9d%90%9a-%f0%9d%90%aa%f0%9d%90%ae%f0%9d%90%9a%f0%9d%90%a5%f0%9d%90%a2%f0%9d%90%ad%f0%9d%90%9e-%f0%9d%90%9d/>). [On 7 May 2026 CANAM launched digital prior-authorisation requests under the AMO](<http://www.canam.ml/index.php/actualite>), exchanged with health facilities through the AMO Anywhere system. [In June 2023 a World Bank paper said the unified social registry built under the Jigiséméjiri project held nearly 1.2 million households at the project's close](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099515109162536671/pdf/IDU-20b55bfe-10dc-41b4-bcef-06b27137e3ce.pdf>). Both 2026 items are from the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says two or more programmes share one registry. Operating would need two or more programmes drawing beneficiaries from one shared registry.

In August 2026 the disaster agency INGD [said its WFP-funded beneficiary management system (SGBAH) was in field pilot ahead of an October 2026 launch](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202608/mozambiques-digital-humanitarian-response-system-set-for-october-launch>). It will be interoperable with the database of INAS, the social action institute that supports vulnerable households. [INGD said the register was being tested in Beira, at a cost WFP put at about 20 million meticais](<https://clubofmozambique.com/news/mozambique-aid-recipient-digital-register-to-be-launched-to-prevent-duplication/>). In the last twelve months, this pilot is the one dated step found. No source found since October 2023 says a registry or programme exchanges data in use. Establishing would need a system in use that exchanges data with the national ID, a payment provider or another programme.

[In March 2025 the World Bank reported 17 users with signed agreements with the Social Registry](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099033125121012030/txt/P171125-e7d2d9de-2891-420a-ac6a-0645e0ccb9c8.txt>), up from seven in July 2020. [The registry coordinator said AOUN cash transfers will be paid under an agreement between Taazour, the Caisse de Depot et de Developpement and GIMTEL](<https://www.ami.mr/archives/261586>). [Taazour launched an AOUN verification platform, reached by SMS link from the registry database](<https://taazour.mr/archives/7559>). Neither source gives a date. No change dated within the last twelve months has been found. No source found since October 2023 says the registry is linked to the national ID and to another sector. Mature would need the registry linked to the national ID and to civil registration, health, education or tax.

In February 2026 [Cabinet said Internet Gratis, for households on the Social Register of Mauritius (SRM), is operational](<https://pmo.govmu.org/CabinetDecision/2026/Highlights%20of%20Cabinet%20Meeting%20Friday%2006%20February%202026.pdf>). A State Informatics platform lets the three internet service providers check whether an applicant is on the SRM database. [In 2024-2025, 7,336 households eligible on the SRM drew the Subsistence Allowance and other schemes](<https://mof.govmu.org/Documents/2026/Annual%20Report%20on%20Performance%20for%20Ministries%20and%20Department/9-1%20Social%20Integration/SOCIAL%20INTEGRATION%20DIVISION%20ANNUAL%20REPORT%202024-2025.pdf>). In the last twelve months, the February 2026 Cabinet record is the dated step found. No source found since October 2023 says the registry is linked to the national ID and to another sector. Mature would need the registry linked to the national ID and to civil registration, health, education or tax.

[As of March 2025 the Unified Beneficiary Registry held 4.2 million households, in 27 of 28 rural districts](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099062325114042048/txt/P169198-441cfc05-221d-412e-9c5e-a5b191e1d0bb.txt>). Five programmes were using the data for targeting and research, a World Bank mission reports. In the last twelve months, [in May 2026 the government launched a data-sharing app for the Malawi Social Registry](<https://www.linkedin.com/posts/giz-malawi_socialprotection-digitaltransformation-activity-7462758236538957824-0WIo>). [In June 2026 a Ministry of Finance economist said integration will link the registry with existing management systems](<https://mwnation.com/ministry-touts-new-social-registry-tool/>). No source found since October 2023 says the registry is linked to the national ID and to another sector. Mature would need the registry linked to the national ID and to civil registration, health, education or tax.

[On 17 June 2026 the first live government-to-person grant payments went through Namibia's instant payment network](<https://technews.com.na/2026/06/17/namibia-moves-government-grant-payments-onto-instant-payment-network/>). [In June 2026 the finance and gender ministries said 15,825 old-age grants were suspended](<https://www.namibian.com.na/system-says-no-to-hungry-pensioners/>), because beneficiaries' names had not been verified in the National Population Registry System. Both are from the last twelve months. [In March 2021 Cabinet adopted a policy saying there was no integrated management information system for social protection](<https://www.civic264.org.na/images/pdf/2022/4/Social_Protection_Policy_2022_Final.pdf>). [In June 2022 the ministry said a central system held all social grant beneficiaries](<https://hppii.gov.na/activities/activity-2-consolidation-of-social-grants-and-the-food-bank/>). No source found since October 2023 says two or more programmes share one registry. Operating would need two or more programmes drawing beneficiaries from one shared registry.

No stage is set. Nothing has been found since October 2023 that names social protection systems exchanging data in Niger. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Nothing found shows programmes keeping separate lists with no exchange between them or with other systems. Absent would need a source from the past three years that says social protection programmes keep separate lists with no exchange between them or with other systems.

[In 2025 NSIPA said NIN and BVN are integrated into the National Social Register](<https://nsipa.gov.ng/programmes/nassco.html>), where NIMC had validated 1,628,587 NINs. In the last twelve months, [on 25 March 2026 the ministry launched a response system centred on a Unified National Register](<https://fmino.gov.ng/fg-flags-off-one-humanitarian-one-poverty-response-system-with-un-and-other-partners/>). It committed to bringing all existing programmes into it. [In November 2026 the ministry said relief recipients are drawn from verified identity records and the register](<https://punchng.com/how-fg-selects-beneficiaries-for-n50000-relief/>). No source found since October 2023 says two or more programmes share one registry. Operating would need two or more programmes drawing beneficiaries from one shared registry.

The New Times quotes a Ministry of Local Government official saying [the Imibereho registry is integrated with other government databases](<https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/37878/news/rwanda/360000-claimsin-new-social-registryhandled-since-2024>). They include land records and Rwanda Social Security Board salary data. [The World Bank paper says the platform is anchored in the national ID system and interoperates with more than 10 government databases](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099031926174531406/pdf/BOSIB-8f413a7a-fae6-43b1-bf08-93edd39faf53.pdf>). Its results framework counts systems interlinked to the registry, from 0 in July 2022 to a target of 10 by December 2028.
